name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Deliver approved plans through verified PR and release stages with canonical release notes.

interface.shortDescription: Build a verified PR or stay through production
interface.longDescription: Keeps one accountable Sol owner in the invoking task. PR mode ends at a verified unmerged PR; ship and release continue through protected merge, deployment or distribution, and exact production proof, ending only as released or blocked. Optional helpers remain terminal leaves and never own production.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <approved-plan-path>. Use ship instead when I explicitly want the same accountable task to continue through production proof.
